takeaway: The zona fasciculata of the adrenal cortex produces glucocorticoids, mainly cortisol, with basal secretion and bursts in response to ACTH from the anterior pituitary.

lines.text: Which hormone does the zona fasciculata of the adrenal cortex secrete?
The main glucocorticoid under normal conditions is cortisol.
Cortisol mobilises fats, proteins, and carbohydrates, and enhances the activity of glucagon and catecholamines.
This zone secretes a basal level of cortisol, with bursts in response to ACTH from the anterior pituitary gland.
